title: TOPIK II
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public TOPIK II syllabus. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: You hear a speaker say 오늘 오후 세 시에 회의가 있어요 (oneul ohu se si-e hoeuiga isseoyo). What is being announced?
options: A meeting at three in the afternoon
A dinner appointment in the evening
A cancelled class in the morning
A weekend trip outside the city
items.explanation: The speaker says 오후 세 시에 회의가 있어요, so a meeting is scheduled at three in the afternoon. The other options describe a dinner, a cancelled morning class, and a trip, none of which are stated.

items.stem: A speaker says 어제 비가 와서 등산을 못 갔어요 (eoje biga waseo deungsaneul mot gasseoyo). What does the speaker explain?
options: The speaker enjoyed hiking in the snow
The hike was cancelled because of rain
The speaker hiked in spite of the rain
The speaker plans to hike tomorrow
items.explanation: The speaker says 비가 와서 등산을 못 갔어요, meaning the rain prevented the hike. The other options misstate the reason or claim the hike actually happened.

items.stem: A speaker says 창문을 좀 닫아 주시겠어요? (changmuneul jom dada jusigesseoyo?). What is the speaker doing?
options: Complaining that the room is too cold
Politely asking someone to close the window
Asking permission to leave the room
items.explanation: 창문을 좀 닫아 주시겠어요 is a polite request to close the window. It is not an offer to open it, a complaint, or a request for permission to leave.

items.stem: You hear an announcement that says 기차가 십 분 후에 출발한대요 (gichaga sip bun hue chulbalhandaeyo). What does the announcement say?
options: The train is delayed by ten hours
The train has already left the station
The train is cancelled for today
The train departs in ten minutes
items.explanation: 출발한대요 with 십 분 후에 means the train departs in ten minutes. The other options invent a long delay, an already completed departure, or a cancellation.

items.stem: A speaker says 요즘 아침마다 조깅을 하는데 건강이 많이 좋아졌어요 (yojeum achimmada joging-eul haneunde geongangi mani joajeosseoyo). What is the main point?
options: Morning jogging improved the speaker's health
The speaker feels tired every morning
The speaker joined a gym a long time ago
items.explanation: The speaker says health improved a lot because of morning jogging, so better health through jogging is the main point. Stopping exercise, tiredness, and joining a gym are not stated.

items.stem: A speaker says 시험에 떨어져서 너무 속상해요 (siheome tteoreojyeoseo neomu soksanghaeyo). How does the speaker feel?
items.explanation: 속상해요 expresses being upset, and the reason given is failing the exam. Passing, relief, and boredom contradict the stated feeling.

items.stem: You hear 어서 오세요. 몇 분이세요? (eoseo oseyo. myeot buniseyo?). Where is this conversation most likely taking place?
items.explanation: The greeting 어서 오세요 and the question 몇 분이세요, asking the size of the party, are typical of a restaurant host. Banks, libraries, and hospitals open with different questions.

items.stem: A speaker says 이 약을 식후에 하루 세 번 드세요 (i yageul sikhue haru se beon deuseyo). Who is most likely speaking?
options: A tour guide describing a route
A pharmacist or doctor giving instructions
items.explanation: Instructions to take medicine after meals three times a day are medical advice, so a pharmacist or doctor is speaking. A teacher, tour guide, and shop clerk would give unrelated directions.

items.stem: A speaker says 표가 두 장 필요한데 한 장밖에 없어요 (pyoga du jang piryohande han jangbakke eopseoyo). How many more tickets are still needed?
items.explanation: The speaker needs two tickets but has only one, so exactly one more is required. Two, three, and four exceed the stated need.

items.stem: A speaker says 미안하지만 오늘은 약속이 있어서 못 만나요 (mianhajiman oneureun yaksogi isseoseo mot mannayo). What does the speaker do?
options: Declines the meeting because of another commitment
Willingly postpones the meeting to next week
items.explanation: Saying 미안하지만 and citing another appointment declines the meeting. Agreeing, rescheduling willingly, and apologizing for lateness do not match the statement.

items.stem: A speaker says 내일은 오전에 흐리다가 오후에 맑아진대요 (naeireun ojeone heuridaga ohue malgajindaeyo). What will tomorrow's weather be like?
options: Cloudy in the morning then clear in the afternoon
items.explanation: 흐리다가 오후에 맑아진대요 describes cloudy weather turning clear, so that is the forecast. Rain, snow, and wind are not mentioned in the report.

items.stem: A speaker says 이번 주말에 집들이를 하려고 친구들을 초대했어요 (ibeon jumare jipdeurireul haryeogo chingudeureul chodaehaesseoyo). What is the speaker's plan?
options: Hosting a housewarming and inviting friends
items.explanation: 집들이를 하려고 친구들을 초대했어요 means hosting a housewarming and inviting friends. Moving, attending a wedding, and cleaning alone are different plans.

items.stem: A speaker says 지하철이 버스보다 훨씬 빠르고 편해요 (jihacheori beoseuboda hwolssin bbareugo pyeonhaeyo). What is the speaker's opinion?
options: The subway is faster and more convenient than the bus
The bus is faster than the subway
Both forms of transport are equally slow
The subway is cheaper but slower
items.explanation: 지하철이 버스보다 훨씬 빠르고 편해요 states the subway is much faster and more convenient than the bus. The other options reverse or change this comparison.

items.stem: A speaker says 회의는 아홉 시에 시작해서 열한 시에 끝났어요 (hoeui-neun ahop sie sijakhaeseo yeolhan sie kkeunnasseoyo). How long did the meeting last?
items.explanation: From nine until eleven is two hours. The other durations do not match the stated start and end times.

items.stem: A speaker says 도서관에서 책을 빌릴 때 신분증을 꼭 가지고 오세요 (doseogwan-eseo chaegeul billil ttae sinbunjeungeul kkok gajigo oseoyo). What must a person bring to borrow books?
items.explanation: The instruction says 신분증을 꼭 가지고 오세요, so an identification card is required. A fee, permission, and a reservation number are not mentioned.

items.stem: One speaker asks 어디에서 내려야 해요? (eodieseo naeryeoya haeyo?) and the other replies 다음 정류장에서 내리세요 (daeum jeongnyujang-eseo naeriseyo). What are they discussing?
options: What to buy at the market
Where to get off the bus
items.explanation: The question 어디에서 내려야 해요 and the answer 다음 정류장에서 내리세요 concern where to get off, so they discuss a bus stop. Shopping, cooking, and work schedules are unrelated.

items.stem: A speaker says 약속 시간에 늦어서 정말 죄송해요 (yaksok sigane neujeoseo jeongmal joesonghaeyo). What is the speaker doing?
items.explanation: 죄송해요 with being late expresses an apology. Asking the time, cancelling, and thanking someone do not fit the statement.

items.stem: A speaker says 감기에 걸렸으면 따뜻한 물을 많이 마시고 푹 쉬세요 (gamgie geollyeosseumyeon ttatteutan mureul mani masigo puk swiseyo). What advice is given?
options: Drink warm water and rest well
Eat as much spicy food as possible
items.explanation: The advice 따뜻한 물을 많이 마시고 푹 쉬세요 tells the listener to drink warm water and rest. Working, eating spicy food, and exercising are the opposite of this advice.

items.stem: A speaker says 원래는 제주도에 가려고 했는데 표가 없어서 부산으로 바꿨어요 (wollaeneun Jejudo-e garyeogo haenneunde pyoga eopseoseo Busaneuro bakkwosseoyo). Where will the speaker travel?
items.explanation: 표가 없어서 부산으로 바꿨어요 means the destination changed to Busan because tickets were unavailable. Jeju was the original plan, not the final one, and Seoul and Gyeongju are not mentioned.

items.stem: A speaker says 인터넷이 느려서 중요한 파일을 제시간에 못 보냈어요 (inteoneti neuryeoseo jungyohan paireul jesigane mot bonaesseoyo). Why could the file not be sent on time?
options: The internet connection was too slow
items.explanation: 인터넷이 느려서 means the slow internet caused the delay in sending the file. A deleted file, a broken computer, and a moved deadline are not given as reasons.

items.stem: Choose the form that correctly completes 비가 오___ 우산을 챙기세요 (biga o___ usaneul chaenggiseyo), meaning 'Since it is raining, take an umbrella.'
items.explanation: -니까 gives a cause, fitting 비가 오니까 'since it is raining'. -거나 offers alternatives, -지만 marks contrast, and -면서 marks simultaneous actions.

items.stem: Choose the connective that fits 열심히 공부했___ 시험에 떨어졌어요 (yeolsimhi gongbuhaet___ siheome tteoreojyeosseoyo), meaning 'Although I studied hard, I failed the exam.'
items.explanation: -지만 marks concession, fitting 'although I studied hard'. -어서 gives a cause, -면 gives a condition, and -고 simply links two actions.

items.stem: Choose the correct honorific form to complete 할머니께서 진지를 잡수__ (halmeonikeseo jinireul japsu__), meaning 'Grandmother is eating.'
items.explanation: The honorific verb for an elder is 잡수시다, so 잡수세요 is correct. The other endings do not supply the required honorific form.

items.stem: Choose the best completion of 일찍 출발했더니 길이 막히지 않고 ___ (iljjik chulbalhaetdeoni giri makiji anko ___), meaning 'Because we left early, we ___ without traffic.'
options: 차가 고장 났어요 - the car broke down
items.explanation: -더니 sets up a result of leaving early, so arriving early with no traffic is the logical completion. Being late, breaking down, and getting lost contradict the premise.

items.stem: Choose the ending that expresses a supposition in 내일은 비가 오___ (naeireun biga o___), meaning 'It looks like it will rain tomorrow.'
options: 면 안 돼요 (myeon an dwaeyo) - must not
items.explanation: -겠어요 expresses supposition or probability, fitting the prediction that it will rain. -고 있어요 is progressive, and the other endings express obligation or prohibition.

items.stem: In a formal written report, which verb should replace the plain 밥을 먹다 (babeul meokda)?
items.explanation: In a formal report the plain verb 밥을 먹다 is replaced by the formal 식사하다. The other forms are causative, passive, or a spoken question, not a formal equivalent.

items.stem: Arrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph. (가) 그래서 요즘은 아침을 꼭 먹는다. (나) 예전에는 아침을 자주 거르곤 했다. (다) 건강에 좋지 않다는 말을 듣고 나서부터다.
items.explanation: The paragraph moves from a past habit (나) to the reason for change (다) to the present result (가), so 나-다-가 is coherent. The other orders reverse the logic.

items.stem: Choose the meaning of the expression 발이 넓다 (bari neolda) as used in a TOPIK II writing passage.
options: To walk for a very long time
items.explanation: 발이 넓다 is an idiom meaning to have many acquaintances, not literally big feet. Walking long, being clumsy, and the literal reading are incorrect.

items.stem: Which closing is most appropriate for a formal request letter when 이상입니다 would sound too abrupt?
options: 검토해 주시면 감사하겠습니다 - I would appreciate your review
items.explanation: A formal letter closes by politely requesting review with 검토해 주시면 감사하겠습니다. Mealtime, bedtime, and casual farewells are inappropriate in a formal letter.

items.stem: Choose the correct passive form for 문이 바람에 저절로 열___ (muni barame jeojeolro yeol___), meaning 'The door opened by itself in the wind.'
options: 면 안 돼요 (myeon an dwaeyo) - must not open
items.explanation: 열리다 is the passive of 열다, so 열렸어요 means 'got opened'. The plain past, the progressive, and the prohibition form do not express the passive.

items.stem: Choose the correct indirect quotation form in 친구가 내일 온___ 했어요 (chinguga naeil on___ haesseoyo), meaning 'My friend said he would come tomorrow.'
items.explanation: A statement is quoted with -다고, so 온다고 했어요 is correct. -냐고 quotes a question, -자고 quotes a suggestion, and -라고 quotes a command or a copula.

items.stem: Choose the ending that expresses purpose in 한국어를 배우___ 한국에 왔어요 (hangugeoreul baeu___ hangugе wаsseoyo), meaning 'I came to Korea to learn Korean.'
items.explanation: -러 expresses the purpose of movement, fitting 'came in order to learn Korean'. The other endings mark simultaneity, contrast, or cause.

items.stem: Choose the correctly spelled word meaning 'to be difficult' as used in a formal written sentence.
items.explanation: The correct spelling is 어렵습니다. The other forms misspell the stem or the formal ending, producing nonstandard written Korean.

items.stem: Which sentence works best as the opening topic sentence of a paragraph arguing that public transportation should be expanded?
options: 어제 지하철에서 친구를 만났다 - I met a friend on the subway yesterday
대중교통을 늘리면 교통 체증과 환경 오염을 줄일 수 있다 - expanding public transport can reduce traffic jams and pollution
나는 자동차를 별로 좋아하지 않는다 - I do not much like cars
택시 요금이 지난달에 올랐다 - taxi fares rose last month
items.explanation: A topic sentence states the paragraph's argument, so expanding public transport reducing jams and pollution fits. Meeting a friend, disliking cars, and taxi fares are details or opinions.

items.stem: A passage on personal finance states 저축은 미래를 준비하는 가장 기본적인 방법이다. Choose the sentence that best fits as the following conclusion.
options: 그래서 나는 오늘 새 옷을 샀다
그러므로 어릴 때부터 조금씩 모으는 습관을 들여야 한다
그러나 은행은 우리 집에서 멀리 있다
items.explanation: A conclusion about saving follows from the idea that saving prepares for the future, so the habit advice fits. Buying clothes, rejecting saving, and the bank's distance do not follow.

items.stem: For the essay prompt 정보화 사회의 문제점과 해결 방안 (problems of the information society and solutions), which content is most appropriate to include?
options: 개인의 취미 생활 소개 - an introduction to personal hobbies
좋아하는 음식 목록 - a list of favourite foods
지난여름 여행 경험담 - a story from last summer's trip
구체적인 문제점과 실현 가능한 해결책 - concrete problems and feasible solutions
items.explanation: The prompt asks about problems and solutions, so concrete problems and feasible solutions fit. Hobbies, food lists, and travel stories are off topic.

items.stem: Choose the correct form 숙제를 다 하___ 나서 놀았어요 (sukjereul da ha___ naseo norasseoyo), meaning 'I played after finishing my homework.'
items.explanation: -고 나서 means 'after doing', fitting 'after finishing homework'. The other endings express alternatives, contrast, or simultaneity.

items.stem: Choose the correctly spaced sentence meaning 'I can speak Korean.'
items.explanation: The standard written form is 할 수 있어요 with a space between 할 and 수. The other options join the words or split them incorrectly.

items.stem: Choose the connective that fits 날씨가 추웠다. ___ 사람들은 공원에서 운동했다 (nalssiga chuwotda. ___ saramdeureun gongwon-eseo undonghaetda), meaning 'It was cold. Nevertheless, people exercised in the park.'
items.explanation: 그럼에도 불구하고 marks concession, fitting 'nevertheless'. 그래서 gives a result, 왜냐하면 gives a reason, and 즉 restates the previous idea.

items.stem: Choose the sentence style appropriate for the introduction of an academic report.
options: 나 오늘 스마트폰 새로 샀어 - I just bought a new smartphone today
너도 스마트폰 좋아하지? - you like smartphones too, right?
스마트폰 진짜 짜증 나 - smartphones are really annoying
본 보고서는 청소년의 스마트폰 사용 실태를 분석하고자 한다 - this report aims to analyse teenagers' smartphone use
items.explanation: An academic report uses the formal written style 본 보고서는 ...고자 한다. The casual spoken sentences are unsuitable for a report introduction.

items.stem: In a TOPIK II reading passage, which word best completes 난관을 ___ and means 'to overcome a difficulty'?
items.explanation: 극복하다 means to overcome, fitting 난관을 극복하다. 포기하다 means to give up, 회피하다 to avoid, and 반복하다 to repeat, so none fit.

items.stem: Choose the form that fits 아무리 바빠___ 식사는 거르지 마세요 (amuri bappa___ siksaneun georeuji maseyo), meaning 'No matter how busy you are, do not skip meals.'
items.explanation: 아무리 pairs with -도 to mean 'no matter how', so 바빠도 is correct. The other endings do not complete the 아무리 construction.

items.stem: Read 저는 주말마다 지역 도서관에서 아이들에게 책을 읽어 주는 봉사를 합니다. 아이들이 책을 좋아하게 되는 모습을 보면 보람을 느낍니다. What is the main idea?
options: The writer dislikes spending time at the library
The writer works as a professional teacher
The writer finds meaning in volunteering to read to children
The writer wants to sell books to children
items.explanation: The writer describes volunteering and feeling 보람, so finding meaning in volunteering is the main idea. Disliking the library, being a teacher, and selling books are not supported.

items.stem: Read 환경을 보호하려면 일회용품 사용을 줄여야 합니다. 작은 실천이 큰 변화를 만듭니다. What is the writer urging?
options: Reducing the use of disposable products
items.explanation: The passage urges reducing disposable products because small actions help the environment. Buying more plastic, stopping recycling, and driving more contradict it.

items.stem: Read 승규는 매일 밤늦게까지 게임을 하느라 수업 시간에 자주 졸았고 결국 기말 시험에서 낮은 점수를 받았습니다. What can be inferred?
options: Staying up late to play games harmed his studies
Seunggyu studied very hard every night
Seunggyu received the highest score in the class
Seunggyu stopped playing games early each night
items.explanation: Late-night gaming led to dozing and a low score, so the inference is that staying up harmed his studies. The other options contradict the passage.

items.stem: In the sentence 그는 어려운 상황에서도 늘 씩씩하게 행동했다, what does 씩씩하게 mean?
items.explanation: 씩씩하게 describes acting bravely and energetically even in hard situations. Sadly, slowly, and angrily do not match the meaning.

items.stem: A passage says 수면 부족은 집중력을 떨어뜨린다 (lack of sleep lowers concentration). Which sentence best follows?
options: 그래서 어젯밤에는 밤을 새웠다 - so I stayed up all night
그러나 잠은 전혀 필요 없다 - however sleep is not needed at all
따라서 충분한 잠을 자는 것이 중요하다 - therefore getting enough sleep is important
즉 커피를 더 많이 마셨다 - that is, I drank more coffee
items.explanation: A conclusion that enough sleep matters follows from the harm of sleep loss. Staying up, denying sleep, and drinking more coffee contradict the passage.

items.stem: Read 장애인을 위한 편의 시설은 특별한 사람만을 위한 것이 아니다. 누구나 나이가 들면 필요해질 수 있다. What is the writer's point?
options: Only disabled people use such facilities
Accessible facilities can benefit everyone eventually
items.explanation: The writer argues such facilities can benefit anyone as they age, so everyone eventually benefits. The other options deny or reverse this point.

items.stem: Read 작년 우리 회사의 매출은 전년 대비 이십 퍼센트 증가했습니다. By how much did sales increase?
items.explanation: 이십 퍼센트 is twenty percent, so sales rose by twenty percent. Two, twelve, and fifty do not match the stated figure.

items.stem: Choose the correct ending for 그 사람은 성실하___ 믿을 수 있다 (geu sarameun seongsilha___ mideoel su itda), meaning 'Because that person is sincere, you can trust him.'
items.explanation: -므로 gives a cause, fitting 'because he is sincere'. -지만 contrasts, -거나 offers alternatives, and -며 lists actions.

items.stem: Read 일회용 컵 대신 텀블러를 쓰는 작은 습관이 지구를 살린다. What is the writer's attitude?
options: Doubting that climate change is real
items.explanation: The writer encourages small habits such as using a tumbler instead of a disposable cup. Mocking, demanding laws, and doubt contradict the encouraging tone.

items.stem: Which word is the opposite of 풍부하다 (pungbuhada, abundant) as used in a TOPIK II passage?
items.explanation: The opposite of 풍부하다 (abundant) is 부족하다 (scarce). 넉넉하다, 많다, and 풍성하다 all mean plentiful or rich, so they are not opposites.

items.stem: Read 규칙적인 운동은 스트레스를 줄이고 잠의 질을 높여 준다. Which two effects are mentioned?
options: Reduced stress and better sleep quality
items.explanation: The passage names two effects, reduced stress and improved sleep quality. The other pairs reverse or invent effects not stated.

items.stem: Choose the correct form for 저는 음악을 듣___을 좋아합니다 (jeoneun eumageul deut___eul joahamnida), meaning 'I like listening to music.'
items.explanation: Verbs are nominalised with -는 것, so 듣는 것을 좋아합니다 is correct. The other endings cannot attach this way to form a noun phrase.

items.stem: Read 꿀벌은 꽃가루를 옮겨 식물이 번식하도록 돕는다. 꿀벌이 사라지면 농작물 생산도 줄어든다. What is the main idea?
options: Bees are dangerous insects to be avoided
Flowers do not need pollination to reproduce
Bees are essential to plant reproduction and crop production
Crop production is unrelated to bees
items.explanation: Bees pollinate plants and support crop production, so the main idea is their essential role. The other options deny or dismiss this relationship.

items.stem: Read the notice 공사로 인해 이번 주 토요일에는 주차장을 이용할 수 없습니다. What is the notice telling readers?
options: The parking lot is free of charge on Saturday
The construction work has already finished
The parking lot is open every day including Saturday
The parking lot is unavailable on Saturday
items.explanation: The notice says the parking lot cannot be used on Saturday due to construction. Free use, finished construction, and daily opening all contradict it.

items.stem: In the passage 그는 발 벗고 나서서 어려운 이웃을 도왔다, what does 발 벗고 나서다 imply?
options: To step forward actively to help
To run away from a difficult task
To take off one's shoes inside the house
To refuse to help a neighbour
items.explanation: 발 벗고 나서다 means to step forward actively to help. Running away, removing shoes at home, and refusing help are wrong readings of the idiom.

items.stem: Read 종이책은 전자책보다 집중하기 쉽지만 이동할 때 불편하다. According to the passage, what is one advantage of paper books?
options: They are lighter to carry around
They are easier to concentrate on
They are usually cheaper to buy
items.explanation: The passage says paper books are easier to concentrate on but inconvenient to carry, so concentration is the advantage. Lighter, cheaper, and backlit are unstated or describe e-books.

items.stem: Read 회사는 직원의 휴식을 권장한다. 쉬는 시간이 늘수록 오히려 업무 효율이 높아졌다. What is the main idea?
options: Adequate rest can improve work efficiency
The company has banned all breaks
items.explanation: Efficiency rose as break time increased, so adequate rest can improve efficiency. The other options contradict the passage's finding.

items.stem: Read 1인 가구가 늘면서 소포장 식품과 소형 가전의 수요가 증가하고 있다. What is the cause of the rising demand?
options: A sharp fall in the total population
The growth of large extended families
A sudden drop in food prices
items.explanation: The passage links rising demand for small-portion food and small appliances to the growth of single-person households. The other options are not given as causes.
